reason: The free first visit and the gated Baby Nook make it worth a Saturday try. I'd pay for one weekend visit only if the baby feels safe, and I'm not signing up for a monthly plan on a $59k budget.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? Fifteen dollars every Saturday adds up fast, and I only get weekends.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing that the Baby Nook really is separate and gated from the bigger kids, plus a weekend price closer to $10.
